entities.summary: Bishop Eduard Kava, O.F.M. Conv. is a Ukrainian Roman Catholic prelate, who is serving as the Diocesan Bishop of Kamianets-Podilskyi since 1 July 2025. Previously he was a Titular Bishop of Cilibia and Auxiliary bishop of Archdiocese of Lviv since 13 May 2017 until 1 July 2025.
